visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a grey V-neck sweater and silver hoop earrings, sits in front of a neutral-colored wall. She holds several makeup products from hince and Dasique towards the camera, smiling warmly. (2) The scene shifts to the woman holding a large pink 'Rose Presso' gift box by hince. She gestures with her hands as she speaks, then proceeds to open the top flap of the pink box. (3) A close-up shows a pink egg-shaped balm container with 'hince' printed on it. A hand opens the lid to reveal a creamy rose-colored balm. The woman then swatches the balm onto the back of her hand. (4) The woman holds a dusty rose lipstick tube. She opens it, showing the applicator, and then applies the color to her lips, smiling at the result. (5) She presents two small white and pink boxes of 'Mad Peach' blush. The scene cuts to a close-up of a clear jar containing a peach-colored cream blush, which she then dabs onto her cheek. (6) A large white palette containing 20 individual jelly-like lip and cheek balms from Dasique is shown. The woman holds the palette and points to various colors. (7) She pulls a pink flower-shaped balm container from the palette. A notification overlay briefly appears on screen. She swatches the '#2 Peach Drop' color on her cheekbone. (8) She shows the '#19 Coco Berry' shade, applying it to her lips with a small applicator brush and then blending it into her cheeks with her fingertips. (9) The woman showcases the '#8 Cinnamon Jam' shade, which is a warm terracotta-pink jelly. She applies it to her lips and poses with the product. (10) The camera returns to a medium shot of the woman. She claps her hands together and gestures heart shapes with her fingers while explaining the giveaway rules. (11) She continues to speak directly to the camera, gesturing downwards to where the comment section would be, ending with a friendly wave and a smile.
